purpose: Canonical evidence ownership ledger for the same-date V3/V4 comparison. Every observation has one primary owner; references elsewhere must not create a second score contribution.

rapidDropReview.note: No four-week V4 shadow baseline exists for this first snapshot.

observations.label: Budget balance, debt burden and r-g bridge
observations.summary: V4 bridge retains the reviewed V3 public-finance state pending a continuous revenue, interest burden and r-g series.
observations.sourceText: Reviewed V3 fiscal data pack as of 2026-07-22

observations.label: Official reserve assets
observations.unit: USD billion; 5.5 months of imports and government external debt service
observations.summary: BI reported June 2026 reserves of USD145.6bn, equivalent to 5.5 months of imports and government external debt service.

observations.label: External funding and holder structure
observations.summary: External debt and foreign ownership structure are retained as the funding-mismatch bridge; short-term portfolio sentiment is excluded.
observations.sourceText: Reviewed BI/Ministry of Finance structure data in production V3

observations.label: Confirmed contingent and quasi-fiscal exposures
observations.summary: Bridge score uses confirmed guarantees and balance-sheet exposures only. DSI timing/scope uncertainty is excluded and belongs to policy predictability.
observations.sourceText: Reviewed production V3 contingent-liability evidence pool

observations.label: S&P sovereign rating
observations.summary: BBB, stable outlook.

observations.label: Fitch sovereign rating
observations.summary: BBB, negative outlook.

observations.label: Moody's sovereign rating
observations.summary: Baa2, negative outlook.

observations.label: Inflation relative to target
observations.summary: Reviewed June inflation state used without FX or reserve duplication.
observations.sourceText: BPS/BI inflation series cited in production V3

observations.label: Rupiah spot stress
observations.summary: Rupiah returned below 18,000; V3 reproducible driver score is 38. Official project FX conversion remains fixed at 15,000 for historical comparability and is not this stress input.
observations.sourceText: Reviewed weekly market snapshot for PR #2

revision.why: 同样受错基数影响（原文写 V3 driver = 38），但该期用的是 V4 输入 schemaVersion 2、本条观测没有 scoreInputs，当前算分器无法重放，故**不可重算**。保留原值并标 fxBasis=legacy——这不代表它正确，只代表算不了。

observations.label: Market access bridge
observations.summary: Migration average of the existing equity/foreign-flow and sovereign risk-pricing drivers; no reserve input is included.
observations.sourceText: Production V3 driver evidence as of 2026-07-22

observations.label: DSI timing and scope change
observations.summary: The reviewed DSI timing/scope shift is counted once as a policy-predictability event, not again as a fiscal deduction.
observations.sourceText: Reviewed PR #2 evidence and production changeReason

observations.label: Government effectiveness migration proxy
observations.summary: External governance assessment is retained only as a bridge for implementation capacity, not as a full composite repeated across institutional drivers.

observations.label: Unique legal impartiality case pool
observations.summary: Legal-process observations are owned here. Any armed standoff dimension is a separate observation owned by coercive cohesion.

observations.label: Institutional checks event pool
observations.summary: Only capture/independence events contribute; macro outcomes do not.

observations.label: Governing coalition continuity
observations.summary: Bridge uses public exit, defection, dismissal and coalition-fracture signals only.

observations.label: Household livelihood stress
observations.summary: Labour-market pressure bridge; PMI headline is excluded.

observations.label: BI consumer confidence
observations.summary: Latest reviewed BI consumer-confidence input.
observations.sourceText: BI consumer confidence series cited in production V3

observations.label: Online grievance proxy
observations.summary: Crawler output is retained because it measures a distinct channel, but GDELT/Trends coverage was degraded and the baseline is shorter than the 12-week promotion gate.

observations.label: Offline mobilisation event pool
observations.summary: Reviewed protest evidence remained within the existing band; no subjective weekly point bump was applied.

observations.label: Armed interagency incident registry
observations.summary: Each standoff or armed conflict has one eventId. Legal-process implications, if any, are not scored here.
observations.sourceText: Production V3 military-police conflict event list

observations.label: Military role-boundary registry
observations.summary: Formal civilian-role expansion and appointments only; the same law or appointment is not repeated in another driver.
observations.sourceText: Production V3 military civilian-role event list

observations.label: Vertical command-chain bridge
observations.summary: Low-confidence migration placeholder pending a direct refusal, abnormal-transfer, public-disagreement and dual-command registry.

observations.label: Security leadership discipline bridge
observations.summary: Low-confidence migration placeholder restricted to security-leadership defection, refusal and public factionalisation signals.
